q_ref: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales, discounts GROUP BY order_referrer_source SINCE 2026-10-20 UNTIL 2026-11-18
q_nr: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales, discounts GROUP BY new_or_returning_customer SINCE 2026-10-20 UNTIL 2026-11-18
q_utm: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_that_completed_checkout GROUP BY utm_source, utm_medium SINCE 2026-10-20 UNTIL 2026-11-18
q_month: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_that_completed_checkout GROUP BY referrer_source TIMESERIES month SINCE 2026-06-01 UNTIL 2026-11-18（11月は18日分）
q_code: FROM sales SHOW orders, gross_sales, discounts GROUP BY discount_code SINCE 2026-10-01 UNTIL 2026-11-18
q_email: FROM sessions SHOW sessions, sessions_that_completed_checkout WHERE utm_source = 'shopify_email' TIMESERIES day SINCE 2026-10-20 UNTIL 2026-11-18
